messages.content: The hotel says the attached garage will be closed Tuesday and Wednesday night. Confirm exactly where they are sending us, what it costs, and whether we should switch to the Home2 instead.

Your room is unchanged under DT-573826: two queens for Marcus, Daniel, and Owen, March 23-28. Room and estimated tax remain $985.40, and free cancellation still ends at 11:59 p.m. local time March 21. For Tuesday and Wednesday, the hotel is directing guests to the Argyle Garage at 225 N. Euclid Avenue, about 0.3 mile away, or a six-minute walk. It is $20 per 24-hour period and has no in-and-out privileges. The DoubleTree garage remains $12 nightly for Sunday, Monday, and Thursday.
Compare leaving the car there for both days with taking it out for Forest Park each day.

Leaving it parked produces $76 total parking: $36 at the hotel for three nights plus $40 at Argyle for two 24-hour periods. Driving out and returning on both Forest Park days can start two additional garage charges, raising Argyle to as much as $80 and total parking to $116. That would make the hotel-and-parking total $1,101.40 instead of $1,061.40.
Then leave it parked. How do we handle Forest Park and downtown?

For the Forest Park days, use rideshares from the hotel and budget roughly $36-$52 total for two family round trips, depending on timing. For downtown, walk back from Argyle toward the hotel and continue to the Central West End MetroLink station; allow about 15 minutes on foot from the garage. Three day passes cost $15 per day, so one downtown day is $15.
Does the disruption justify moving to the Home2 we kept as the other option?

No. Home2's king studio with the confirmed double sofa bed is still available for these dates at $1,128.90 including estimated tax and parking. Keeping the DoubleTree, leaving the car at Argyle, and adding one $15 transit day totals $1,076.40 before the Forest Park rideshares. Even at the high rideshare estimate, it remains slightly cheaper, preserves the two-queen room, and avoids changing hotels. Keep DT-573826 and use the temporary garage plan.
